essence:
In V3-C, Abhinava established that the pramāṇa operates *on the appearance alone*
(ābhāsamātre), not on the bare own-marker thing apart from all manifestation.

> As the taste, as the wish, as the derivation — the appearance, even of one object established by
> the synthesis (anusandhāna), is divided.
At first sight the jar is one — but the discriminating mind divides it.
